title: Customer Reschedule Fee on Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts — Posting Reference
content:
Ridgeline Installation Services charges a customer reschedule fee for a customer reschedule of a booked installation that the scheduling rules do not make free. A customer reschedule those rules make free carries no customer reschedule fee and is outside this rule.

## What is charged and against which request

- The customer reschedule fee is charged for the most recent customer reschedule request on the contract that was carried out (request status completed).
- The customer reschedule fee posts as one reschedule fee line on the contract, referencing the reschedule request it arises from, at the amount the customer reschedule fee rule fixes.
- Once posted, the line appears on the contract's statement of charges and the contract's balance due rises by the fee.

## Invocation

The fee is posted with the agent-side tool `post_reschedule_fee_05a0220d`. The agent unlocks the tool and then calls it; one call adds one reschedule fee line, dated the day it is posted.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `install_contract_id` | the reference number of the installation contract the fee is charged on, as returned by the installation contract lookup for the customer | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `install_request_id` | the reference number of the customer reschedule request the fee arises from, as returned by the installation service request lookup for that contract | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `fee_amount` | the reschedule fee charged, in USD | a positive amount written to 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half to even to the cent when it is recorded |

## Return

The tool returns a receipt with `install_charge_id` (the reference number of the new fee line), `install_contract_id` (the contract charged), `contract_number` (the contract number exactly as on the contract), `fee_type` (always `reschedule_fee`), `amount` (the fee posted, in USD to 2 decimal places), `charge_date` (today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (the contract's balance due after the fee, in USD to 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying an `install_charge_id` means the fee is on the contract.

## Basis questions answered

**Which reschedule request is the fee line tied to?** The most recent customer reschedule request on the contract whose status is completed, the request that was carried out.

**Does a free customer reschedule produce a fee line of 0.00?** No. A customer reschedule the scheduling rules make free carries no customer reschedule fee and is outside this rule.
